title: Anthropic Discloses Decryption of Two Cryptographic Algorithms, Breaks Post-Quantum Candidate Scheme in 60 Hours
excerpt: Anthropic's AI model, Claude Mythos Preview, recently successfully identified mathematical vulnerabilities in the encryption algorithms that underpin global dig
content_html:
Anthropic's AI model, Claude Mythos Preview, recently successfully identified mathematical vulnerabilities in the encryption algorithms that underpin global digital security, demonstrating the autonomous reasoning and attack capabilities of large models in complex cryptography fields.

In research targeting the post-quantum signature scheme candidate algorithm HAWK from the U.S. National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST), Mythos developed an improved attack by exploiting previously unnoticed symmetries in "mathematical lattices" within a multi-agent semi-autonomous system. This breakthrough solved a problem that had been reviewed by human experts for over two years, all within 60 hours and with a $100,000 API cost.

Additionally, regarding the most widely used symmetric encryption standard in the world—simplified AES-128 (7-round modified version)—Mythos independently developed a new fingerprint identification attack method called "Mobius Bridge" with only three intervention prompts and consuming 1 billion tokens (approximately $100,000 cost). This method increased attack efficiency by 200 to 800 times.

Although Anthropic emphasized that these breakthroughs do not affect currently running systems, and that Mythos Preview is still not open to the public, the company has completed vulnerability coordination disclosure with the U.S. government, industry partners, and HAWK developers. It has also collaborated with institutions such as ETH Zurich to launch the CryptanalysisBench benchmark test. This development indicates that AI is posing unprecedented challenges to the core assumptions underlying internet security.

content_html_zh:
Anthropic的AI模型Claude Mythos Preview最近成功识别了支撑全球数字安全的加密算法中的数学漏洞，展示了大型模型在复杂密码学领域的自主推理和攻击能力。

在针对美国国家标准与技术研究所 (NIST) 的后量子签名方案候选算法 HAWK 的研究中，Mythos 通过利用多智能体半自治系统中“数学晶格”中以前未被注意到的对称性开发了一种改进的攻击。 这一突破解决了人类专家审查了两年多的问题，所有这些都在 60 小时内完成，API 成本为 10 万美元。

此外，针对全球使用最广泛的对称加密标准——简化版AES-128（7轮修改版），Mythos自主开发了一种名为“莫比乌斯桥”的新型指纹识别攻击方法，仅需3次干预提示，消耗10亿枚代币（成本约10万美元）。 这种方法使攻击效率提高了200到800倍。

尽管Anthropic强调这些突破不会影响当前运行的系统，并且Mythos Preview仍未向公众开放，但该公司已与美国政府、行业合作伙伴和HAWK开发者完成了漏洞协调披露。 它还与苏黎世联邦理工学院等机构合作推出了CryptanalysisBench基准测试。 这一发展表明人工智能正在对互联网安全的核心假设构成前所未有的挑战。
